Ms. Shanti Tiwari - Panel Lawyer for the State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 89/2023 dated 12.9.2023 registered at Police Station Rampur Gurra, District Narmadapuram (Hoshangabad) for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 376(2)(cha), 376(3), 376(2)(N) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 5 and 6 of the Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. The counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
It is submitted that the statement of the prosecutrix (PW-1) has been recorded before the trial Court during trial.
She has not supported the case of the prosecution and has turned hostile.
The DNA report of the applicant is also negative.

It is further submitted that the applicant is in custody since 30.9.2023 (for more than 1 year) and trial would take considerable time to conclude, therefore, the applicant be NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:60940 2 MCRC-52934-2024 released on bail.
3. The counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that at the time of commission of offence, the prosecutrix was minor aged about 13 years.
Thus, looking to the gravity of offence, the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties and perused the case diary.

5 . Although the prosecutrix has not supported the case of the prosecution before the trial Court during trial and has turned hostile, however, in paragraph 1 of her testimony she has specifically levelled allegations against the applicant.

Therefore, considering the age of the prosecutrix which, as per prosecution was 13 years at the time of commission of offence and Paragraph 1 of her testimony,
this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.

(MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE PB Shubham @ Shivam Kahar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129285124/
